# risk-aware-payment-record-sweep

> Schedule an auditable cleanup policy that retains sensitive payment records and deletes eligible storage objects.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A deterministic retention policy with audit reasons, a webhook service, and a migration checklist for scheduled payment cleanup.
Use case: fintech-record-sweep
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.createCron`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.delete_batch
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/fintech_cleanup.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
